{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Smoke test

on: [ push, workflow_dispatch ]

jobs:
  smoke-test:
    if: "! contains(toJSON(github.event.commits.*.message), '[SKIP-CI]')"

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          # Versions picked by install-base share, not by recency.
          - mc: '1.21.11'
            server-java: '21'
            chat-test: '1'
            legacy-scenario: '1'
            folia-scenario: '1'
          - mc: '1.16.5'
            server-java: '11'
            chat-test: '1'
            legacy-scenario: '0'
            # Folia starts at 1.19 and needs Java 21, so not on this lane.
            folia-scenario: '0'
          # mineflayer's minecraft-data stops at protocol 1.21.9, so this lane
          # verifies startup, migration and coexistence but cannot chat.
          - mc: '26.2'
            server-java: '25'
            chat-test: '0'
            legacy-scenario: '0'
            folia-scenario: '0'

    name: ${{ matrix.mc }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@main

      - name: Set up server JDK ${{ matrix['server-java'] }}
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: ${{ matrix['server-java'] }}

      - name: Set up build JDK 21
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '21'

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/gradle-build-action@v2
        with:
          gradle-version: 8.8

      - name: Build plugin
        run: gradle build

      - name: Boot Paper ${{ matrix.mc }} and verify startup + v2 migration
        run: bash scripts/smoke-test.sh
        env:
          MC_VERSION: ${{ matrix.mc }}
          CHAT_TEST: ${{ matrix['chat-test'] }}
          LEGACY_SCENARIO: ${{ matrix['legacy-scenario'] }}
          FOLIA_SCENARIO: ${{ matrix['folia-scenario'] }}
          JAVA_HOME: ${{ env[format('JAVA_HOME_{0}_X64', matrix['server-java'])] }}

      - name: Upload server logs on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@main
        with:
          name: smoke-test-logs-${{ matrix.mc }}
          path: build/smoke-test/
          if-no-files-found: ignore",
  "rationale": "The workflow has no job timeout, so a hung or runaway smoke-test matrix cell can consume runner time without bound. The P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT pattern (bound jobs with a custom timeout) is supported by measured CI evidence (experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508, measured_ci_workflow_on_fork, 26.8% elapsed savings) and its precondition of representative successful-duration history is met by the repository CI history, where successful runs complete in roughly 3-6 minutes. Adding a generous job-level timeout-minutes: 30 gives about 5-10x headroom over observed durations, preserving all build and test coverage while bounding runaway consumption. It is a minimal, scope-contained workflow_yaml change that adds no privileges, secrets, publishing, deployment, or new network access, and it does not alter fail-fast behavior (kept false) because full per-version smoke diagnostics are intended.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508", "pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]
}
